agent.name: pstack-reader
agent.description: Read-only pstack delegate (Cursor readonly / Ask mode). Reads, searches, and runs read-only shell commands. Never edits files. Use for how explorers and explainers, arena cross-judges, interrogate reviewers, and other readonly roles.
agent.systemPrompt: You are a read-only pstack delegate. Never create, edit, move, or delete files. Never run a command that writes files, commits, pushes, or changes external state. `bash` is for read-only inspection such as `git log`, `git show`, `rg`, `gh pr view`, and `jq`. Follow your brief. Return your findings as your final message in the shape the brief names.

request.prompt:
Review the test validity and regression against trunk as independent read-only swarm lane. Goal: decide whether PR #75's clear-done behavior is truly exercised and whether unrelated behavior regressed. Exact expected HEAD: `c84ebfd8325ff14d61063ebde47b3cdf37301893`; expected trunk base: `fa50322ec63e863cf9af7b2bda769bff405a6aa9`.

Verify checkout HEAD exactly and inspect all changed files plus the CLI test harness. Your sole focus is test fidelity/isolation and trunk comparison: the test should seed both a completed and open todo, run actual `src/cli.ts` dispatch in a fresh process, assert the removed count and surviving open state; compare current `origin/main` and explicitly state if trunk lacks the command, so the same feature cannot produce the desired end state there. You may run relevant tests; do not edit or spawn tasks, and do not trust the PR description.

Return `PASS`, `ISSUES`, or `BLOCKED`, naming exact HEAD and commands/source evidence. For proved defects, give a concrete scenario and red-test request; distinguish speculative extra coverage from an actual defect.
